title: Appearance Preferences
description: Per-user appearance-preferences UI driven by the `customizable` field. Per-user overrides persist via `/wp-admin-workspaces/v1/user-prefs`. NOT the wp-admin Appearance hub (themes / editor / menus) — this is a personalization panel (density / accent / default-route).

documentation.purpose: Per-user customization screen for workspace appearance. Reads the active workspace's `customizable` declarations from the resolved config and renders ONLY the controls the workspace allows. MVP controls: density (default / compact / comfortable), accent color (color picker that writes a single token override), default-route override (text input for landing path). Saves go through `POST /wp-admin-workspaces/v1/user-prefs`; the server deep-merges onto the existing prefs blob and the resolver re-runs on next mount.

reads.purpose: Active workspace's customizable allowlist + current resolved values (read from the resolved workspace.json tree, used as fallbacks when prefs are empty).

writes.purpose: Patch user prefs via POST with the changed key only — server deep-merges.
DELETE wipes all per-user overrides (Reset to workspace defaults).

states.renders: Centered Spinner — waiting for initial fetch.

states.when: Nothing is customizable for this workspace
states.renders: Empty-state copy explaining the workspace has locked customization.

states.when: prefs !== null and at least one control is allowed
states.renders: Stack of controls — only those the workspace allows render.
Controls disabled; save button shows loading.

interactions.effect: Fetch `/wp-admin-workspaces/v1/user-prefs`; on success set state to result; on failure set state to `{}`.
POST `{ styles: { density } }` to user-prefs; success snackbar.
POST `{ styles: { color: { bg: { interactive: { brand: { strong: value } } } } } }`.
DELETE `/wp-admin-workspaces/v1/user-prefs` to clear all per-user overrides; on success local `prefs` state resets to `{}` and a snackbar confirms.

constraints.note: Server enforces `customizable` via the cascade resolver. Controls hidden here are a UX nicety; an attacker hand-crafting a POST cannot bypass the server-side default-deny.
`customizable` is either a boolean or a string-array allowlist. Other types (object, number) are treated as locked, with a dev-mode console warn. This matches the server-side default-deny posture.
POST body is a partial — server deep-merges onto existing prefs. Sending `{ styles: { density: 'compact' } }` doesn't clobber `styles.color.*`.

The color picker doesn't fall back to a literal hex when accent is unset — WPDS provider supplies `--wpds-color-bg-interactive-brand-strong`. Empty string = no override; picker reads the resolved CSS var directly.
WordPress hook `wp_admin_workspaces_user_prefs` user-meta updates triggers the cascade cache flush; next page-load resolves the new prefs.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Form layout + color hex input + default-route input + save buttons.
